Class Array

Namespace
BOOSEapp
Assembly
BOOSEapp.dll

Array interpreter extension for BOOSE, adding support for array variables. Supports int variables, real variables, int arrays, real arrays, together with poke, peek and simple write commands.

public class Array : IInterpreter
